//: Firestore index source of truth. Deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`. Single-field equality queries are automatic; composites are listed below.
//ttl: TTL policies are declared under fieldOverrides ("ttl": true), because the Firebase CLI lists every live TTL policy as a field override and, on `deploy --only firestore:indexes`, treats one missing from this file as a deletion (refused without --force; NEVER pass --force, it deletes the policy). Each override must also restate the field's live single-field indexes: an empty `indexes` there disables single-field indexing on the field. All three mirror the database default (ascending, descending, array-contains; `gcloud firestore indexes fields describe <field> --collection-group=<group>`), so a deploy against a project that already has them writes nothing. `challenges.expireAt`: consume_nonce deletes a nonce on use; TTL reclaims the ones never consumed. `audit_logs.expireAt` (TD-237; one year, owner decision 2026-10-22): repo/audit_log.add_audit_row sets it to the row's time + AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS, and scripts/stamp_audit_licence_ids.py (TD-246) on rows from before; the policy is enabled by hand after the audit-trail log bucket is locked (docs/backend/FIRESTORE_DATA_PROTECTION.md, "The audit trail is append-only"), and declared here so an indexes deploy keeps it (one run before that step creates it). Without it audit rows are kept for ever.
//ttl-deleted: Deleted licences are held 30 days: `deleted_licenses.purgeAt` and `deleted_seats.purgeAt` (the seats under each) are TTL fields, declared in fieldOverrides (docs/backend/BACKEND_SETUP_CONSOLE.md step 3a). Without the policies a deleted licence is never purged; restore still refuses one past purgeAt.
//licenses: The staff desk lists licences newest first (createdAt DESC), filtered by mode unless Demo keys are shown and by status (an `in` filter) when revoked ones are hidden: repo/license_admin.list_licenses. One index per filter combination.
//files: The account export streams the caller's files ordered by session (where uid ==, order by sessionId) and merges them with the sessions: repo/sessions.iter_sessions_with_files.
//audit_logs: Institution IT read their own licence's audit log newest first, optionally within dates (where licenseId ==, ts range, order by ts DESC): audit.page_license_audit. `audit.record` stamps licenseId on licence, seat, invite and lease events from 2026-10-18; older events are not in that export.
//seats-uid: Account erasure finds every seat an account held, on any licence, live or in a deleted licence's hold (where uid ==, as a collection group): repo/account._seats_of (TD-243). A collection-group query has no automatic index, so `seats.uid` and `deleted_seats.uid` enable the ascending index at COLLECTION_GROUP scope; each override restates the three COLLECTION-scope defaults, as the TTL overrides do. Until it is deployed the query fails and erasure blanks the current licence's seat only (`seatScanComplete: false`).
